headline: Record quarter for Avnet as margins expand across the board
summary_short: Avnet's fiscal Q4 2026 sales hit a record $8,295.4M, up 47.7% y/y and 16.5% q/q, with adjusted diluted EPS of $2.28 (+181.5% y/y) as Electronic Components (4.1% margin) and Farnell (9.0% margin) both posted record segment operating margins.
summary_long: Fourth-quarter sales hit a record $8,295.4M, up 47.7% y/y and 16.5% q/q, with growth across every EC region and Farnell. GAAP operating margin expanded 147bp y/y to 2.8% (though it slipped 11bp q/q); adjusted operating margin rose 129bp y/y to 3.8%, with EC at a record 4.1% and Farnell at a record 9.0%. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.49 versus $0.07 a year ago; adjusted diluted EPS was $2.28, up 181.5% y/y and grew 3.8x faster than sales. Inventory days fell 6 q/q to 71. Cash fell to $155.4M from $192.4M y/y while total debt rose to $3,212.8M, after the year's $633.75M convertible-notes issuance and $550M note repayment. Avnet guided Q1 FY2027 sales to $9.00B-$9.30B and adjusted diluted EPS to $2.80-$2.90.
